gameDescriptionHtml:
Hexocity is a relaxing puzzle game set up in a futuristic world. Inspired by the great “Dorfromantik” we have decided to make this game to build our team with a limit of 6 months of development.

Build your archipelago while listening to relaxing synthwave music.

Hexocity is a relaxing puzzle game where you place hexagonal tiles and win points by connecting the same elements.

You start with a limited number of tiles and the game ends when you reach 0. Some features will allow you to win more tiles so you can extend the game duration.
Make the best score before the end!

PERFECTS
Make perfect tiles to win powers & a bonus of points and 1 more tile.

POWERS
Use powers that will be given to you with each perfect :
Refresh: change the current tile
Generate: select an empty spot and get a tile that fits perfectly
Delete: delete the selected tile.
Copy : copy an existing tile

QUESTS
Win bonuses of points & tiles with quests.
Connect 2 Roads : place your ending point and place tiles to connect both points. The shortest path gives a bonus.
Connect 2 Canals : Place your ending point and place tiles to connect both points. All tiles give a bonus.

CREATIVE MODE
Create your own islands with no limits in the creative mode.

There is a little more than an hour of original soundtrack in Hexocity, composed by Way16a’s composer: Raphael Ledent.

Let yourself flow with the relaxing synthwave of Hexocity.
